description: This file is a Go source code file implementing a parser for structured tags within the Kubernetes codebase, specifically for parsing tag strings into structured Tag objects with support for arguments, values, and comments.

classes.name: scanner
classes.description: A helper struct for scanning and tokenizing the input string during parsing.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a tag string into a Tag object, with optional parsing options.

methods.name: ParseAll
methods.description: Parses multiple tag strings into a slice of Tag objects.

methods.name: RawValues
methods.description: Returns a ParseOption that enables raw value parsing mode.

methods.name: parseTag
methods.description: Core function that performs the parsing of a single tag string into a Tag object.

methods.name: isIdentBegin
methods.description: Checks if a rune can begin an identifier.

methods.name: isIdentInterior
methods.description: Checks if a rune can be inside an identifier.

methods.name: isTagNameInterior
methods.description: Checks if a rune can be inside a tag name.
